 1:Total Precipitation depth
 2:Total Irrigation depth

Note: Runoff values refer to runoff from the entire hillslope.  Total detachment
      is the average net detachment over all areas on the hillslope having
      net detachment.  Interrill detachment is the weighted (by OFE length)
      average over the entire hillslope.  Total deposition refers to the
      average net deposition over all the areas on the hillslope experiencing
      net deposition.  Irrigation depths are averages over the entire hillslope.
